bullets.text: Minister R. Kumar inaugurated completed development projects worth Rs 1.08 crore with a 70-bed modern health center in the Adyar zone.
A school van driver was arrested under the POCSO Act in Sengundram for allegedly harassing a five-year-old girl, following initial police inaction.
Anbumani Ramadoss alleged that there is a major conspiracy to misappropriate the Pallikaranai marshland.
Severe traffic congestion in Velachery caused vehicle queues and left motorists struggling to move.
Sudden heavy rain in Chennai and its suburbs brought joy to the local residents.
Southern Railway is awaiting RDSO clearance to fix the platform gap at the new Adambakkam station.
BSLN announced the upcoming launch of 4G services under phase IX.2 in Chennai, Thiruvallur, Kancheepuram, and Chengalpattu districts.
Tiruvallur police solved a burglary case from last October by arresting three Andhra men for stealing 86.5 sovereigns in Pallipattu.
Farmers in Ponneri petitioned the Chief Minister's Special Cell over paddy crop damage caused by substandard weedicide.
Vultr launched a 20-megawatt AI supercompute cluster in Chennai powered by over 10,000 AMD GPUs.
The University of Madras Syndicate approved a MoU with Sutherland Global Services to set up an AI lab.
A controversy over supplying dubious books to Periyar Arivulagam library triggered a blame game between the DMK and TVK.
